attributes.board_name: Rhode Island Board of Licensure of Physician Assistants (RI Department of Health)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Approved continuing medical education (types not listed in the rule)
rules.new_licensee_rule: PAs initially licensed after the July 1 renewal date are exempt until the next renewal cycle (June 30 of the next odd-numbered year).
rules.audit_note: Keep course descriptions, proof of attendance or other documentation for at least 4 years; subject to random audit by the Board.
rules.notes: Rule text says 25 hours 'every years' (apparent typo); accumulation period runs July 1 to June 30. Licenses expire June 30 of odd-numbered years; renewal filed by June 1. Exact period not confirmed (statute site and RIDOH page blocked).
rules.rule_quote: A. Pursuant to R.I. Gen. Laws § 5-54-22 every physician assistant licensed to practice in the State of Rhode Island shall be required to have satisfactorily completed twenty-five (25) hours of approved continuing medical education every years.
